title: Ask the provider for a quote
summary: Create → Quote: it goes to Purchases → Purchase Quotes.
keywords: ask the provider for a quote

steps.title: Menu → Purchases → Providers
steps.details: Labs, suppliers and services the clinic buys from; with their account: quotes, invoices and payments.

steps.title: Find the provider
steps.details: By name, email or tax ID.

steps.title: Ask the provider for a quote
steps.details: Create → Quote: it goes to Purchases → Purchase Quotes.

steps.title: Add item
steps.details: Adds a line to the quote; it can't be saved without at least one.

steps.title: Product or service
steps.details: Choose the purchased product or service; the unit price comes from the catalog.

steps.title: Quantity
steps.details: The line total is recalculated with the quantity.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: Fill in the form and save.
